verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a desktop coding-agent app with an account, chats and settings, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents exporting chats, settings or account data in open formats, or any account-departure path. Bring-your-own provider keys and the agent's git operations on user projects are adjacent features and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
